Enabled.Name: Enable Moment of Glory
Enabled.Hint: When enabled, reducing a hostile creature to 0 HP may prompt a Moment of Glory.

HostilesOnly.Name: Hostile targets only
HostilesOnly.Hint: Only offer Moments of Glory when the defeated creature's disposition is hostile.

IgnorePCs.Name: Ignore player characters
IgnorePCs.Hint: Never offer a Moment of Glory when the creature reduced to 0 HP is a player character.

GM.PromptContent:
{attacker} has reduced {target} to 0 HP.

Offer them a Moment of Glory to describe the finishing blow?

Player.PromptContent:
The GM offers you a Moment of Glory.

Describe how you finish {target}:

Chat.Skipped: {attacker} declines the Moment of Glory against {target}.

Notify.WaitingOnGM: Waiting for the GM to decide on a Moment of Glory…
Notify.WaitingOnPlayer: Waiting for {player} to describe their Moment of Glory…
Notify.Offered: You have been offered a Moment of Glory!
Notify.Declined: Moment of Glory declined — death proceeds normally.
Notify.NoMidi: Moment of Glory: midi-qol not active; falling back to dnd5e damage hooks where possible.
